content.user_title: Search and Rewrite Code with ast-grep
content.value_statement: Text search misses code structure and creates noisy results. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through AST-aware search, linting, and refactoring with ast-grep.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to install and verify the ast-grep CLI.
Shows syntax-aware search patterns for Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
Guides rule authoring with pattern, kind, regex, relationship, and composition rules.
Provides YAML examples for lint rules and automated fixes.
Describes workflows for audits, API migrations, and bulk refactors.
Compares ast-grep with grep and ripgrep for structured code searches.
limitations: Requires ast-grep to be installed before commands can run.
Does not include packaged scripts or automated execution.
Complex rules still need local testing against real code.
Rewrite commands can change many files, so users must review changes.

use_cases.title: Find Structural Code Patterns
use_cases.description: Locate functions, calls, imports, or conditions using syntax-aware ast-grep patterns.

use_cases.title: Migrate APIs Across a Repository
use_cases.description: Plan and test ast-grep rewrites before updating old APIs or imports.

use_cases.title: Audit Risky Code Constructs
use_cases.description: Search for patterns such as dynamic evaluation or unsafe query calls.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Code Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ast-grep skill to find console logging calls in this TypeScript repository. Explain the pattern before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Lint Rule
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ast-grep skill to draft a lint rule for async functions without await. Include a small test plan.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Safe Rewrite
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ast-grep skill to plan a repository rewrite from var declarations to safer declarations. Include review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Complex Rule
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ast-grep skill to debug why my relationship rule misses matches. Suggest smaller checks and stop conditions.

output_examples.input: Find console logging calls in a TypeScript project.
output: Explains the structural search pattern in plain language.
Runs a focused search and reports matching files and lines.
Suggests a review step before removing matches.

output_examples.input: Create a rule to replace unsafe declarations with safer ones.
output: Builds a rule plan with expected matches and exclusions.
Recommends testing on a small sample before repository changes.
Provides a cautious rewrite workflow with review checkpoints.
Searches for eval-style calls using an AST-aware query.
Separates true matches from harmless text references.
Summarizes files that need manual review.

best_practices: Test each rule on a small example before scanning a repository.
Review matches before running rewrite commands.
Use relationship rules with clear stop conditions for complete searches.
anti_patterns: Running bulk rewrites without reviewing matches first.
Using plain text search when the task depends on syntax.
Treating example patterns as universal rules without adapting language and context.

faq.question: Does this skill install ast-grep for me?
faq.answer: No. It explains installation commands, but users decide when to install tools.

faq.question: Can it modify my code?
faq.answer: The skill can guide rewrite commands. Review matches and use version control before applying changes.

faq.question: Which languages are covered?
faq.answer: The examples cover Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, and YAML rule files. ast-grep supports more languages.

faq.question: Is it better than grep?
faq.answer: It is better for syntax-aware tasks. grep or ripgrep can still be faster for plain text searches.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it include custom scripts?
faq.answer: No. The source is a Markdown guide with command examples and rule patterns.
